rounds.title: Token overview
rounds.note: How the sdk foundations overview draws the corrected token set: surfaces, colour themes, shadow and type

a.note: Swatch matrix: rows per token, columns per state, small labelled chips. Dense and compares states at a glance; reads like a table, not like use.

b.note: Specimen: each surface and colour theme drawn in use - text levels on a panel, filled and ink samples per state, a shadowed card. Shows how tokens combine; single values are harder to read.

c.note: Token sheet: rows of swatch, token name in mono and the value written from the CSS. Exact reference for implementers; longest and least visual.
